Professional fashion photograph, waist-up portrait, vertical portrait-orientation. One woman centred in the frame, face clearly visible, framed from the very top of her head down to just below the navel, the frame cutting off there. Mid 20s.

A Chinese woman, mid 20s, with an extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term multiples pregnancy. Her pregnant belly is exceptionally wide as well as high, stretched into a broad, taut, smoothly rounded dome far wider than an ordinary single pregnancy, the navel pushed flat and outward at its highest point, faint linea nigra running down its centre. A full heavy bust above it, wide round hips below, soft thick thighs and arms. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive rounded middle. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, and a theatrical-film animated heroine look brought to life, with a chin-length chestnut bob and wispy side strands blown by a breeze, each strand real hair with natural shine, fine flyaways and a few loose wisps. Her eyes are huge, perfectly round, gentle eyes with an enormous visible iris in soft emerald-green contact lenses with a darker limbal ring and a round natural pupil, one large bright catchlight and one small catchlight in each iris, a thick drawn lower lash line and long curled lashes, under thin, high, simple brows, with real wet eyes and real eyelid skin around them, the eyes taking up nearly half the width of her face in exaggerated anime proportion, set slightly wider apart than normal, with a crisp dark double-eyelid line and a faint luminous ring of light in each iris. Her lips are small and soft, in a natural rose-pink, curved into a calm warm smile. A deeper pink blush spreads over both cheeks and across the tip of the nose. A tiny nose reduced to a small soft rounded tip with a tiny highlight and a faint shade beneath it, the bridge and nostrils barely visible, a very small simple mouth with the corners lifted slightly, a small pointed chin, and a softly narrowed anime face shape. A fresh, kind, wide-eyed gaze. She is wearing a cosplay costume: a white and sky-blue cinematic heroine crop top with a centre front zipper and delicate gold emblem trim, and a matching ultra micro bikini bottom in the same fabric and colour worn low on her hips beneath the lower curve of her belly, her pregnant belly fully bare above it, her shoulders and arms bare. Jewelry: on each ear, three separate heavy ear weights of real blackened cast iron hanging from a polished silver ring through the lobe, each on its own silver chain of a different length so they hang staggered at different heights and fully visible side by side: on the left ear a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a pyramid-shaped lump, a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim; on the right ear a round bell, a cube-shaped block, a square-sided cowbell. Every weight is a dense, solid, rough, matte, hammered lump of black cast iron about the size of a large walnut, hanging freely in the air with the longest weight ending at the level of her collarbones, and their weight gently pulls each earlobe down into a soft, slightly elongated, healthy loop of smooth skin. At her neck she wears real layered gold chains of different lengths resting on her collarbones.

Background: a softly blurred sunlit green meadow under towering white summer clouds.

Her skin, across her face, neck, shoulders, chest, arms and belly, is real human skin with visible fine pores across the nose and cheeks, a few tiny freckles and small beauty marks on her face, shoulders, chest, arms and belly, a faint uneven warmth with a pink flush on the cheeks and the tip of the nose, a soft shadow under the eyes, fine natural lines at the corners of the eyes and lips, a light natural sheen on the nose, forehead, collarbones and chest, and the rest of her skin in a soft natural matte finish, real living flesh with warmth. She is a professional cosplayer in a flawless cosplay transformation: large circle lenses, thick false lashes with drawn lower lashes, eyelid tape for a wide double lid, contouring that shrinks the nose and sharpens the chin, and a high-quality wig with a natural hairline and real-looking strands. Her pregnant belly is the visible centerpiece of her frame.
Lighting: bright, soft, even light across her face with only gentle shading. Shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. 8K vertical portrait-orientation 3:4 aspect ratio.
